symptoms: Secondary infection in scabies and eczema

management_steps.details: Children <= 7 years of age: 25 mg/kg/dose 12 hourly for 5 days. Children > 7 years of age and adults: 500 mg 6 hourly for 5 days.
Used for bacterial skin infections when systemic antibiotics are indicated.
